verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents RESTful APIs for core directory services and bulk operations across users, devices, and groups. A published API 2.0 spec (index.yaml) describes graph-traversal endpoints that return directly and indirectly bound objects, which implies programmable associations such as app assignments. Official GitHub API examples complement this, but the evidence never addresses pagination, filtering, or the authentication model, and app assignment endpoints are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of pagination and filtering parameters, documented auth scheme (API keys/OAuth), explicit app-assignment endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of API quality.
